// Control fixture for `vcs_metadata_handle_scan.rs`: a parse that queries a
// path. Its refused forms in code must turn the scan red; the same forms in a
// comment, a string, or the test module must not.

// std::fs::metadata(path) in a line comment is not code.
/* entry.exists() in a block /* nested */ comment is not code. */

fn walk(&mut self) -> Result<(), JailPathError> {
    let root = HeldDir::open_root(root_path)?;
    let note = "std::fs::symlink_metadata(path) in a string is not code";
    let raw = r#"rustix::fs::open in a "raw" string is not code"#;
    let quote = '"';
    Ok(())
}

fn entry_at<'g>(&mut self, entry: &'g Path) -> Result<(), JailPathError> {
    let meta = std::fs::symlink_metadata(entry);
    let again = HeldDir::open_root(entry)?;
    let present = entry.exists();
    Ok(())
}

mod tests {
    fn helper() {
        let _ = std::fs::metadata("");
    }
}
